eval_prompt: I only want `cloud.backend.*` highlighted in one view while everything else stays muted. Should that styling live in the model/spec or in the view? Give me a minimal LikeC4 view snippet.
expected_output: The response keeps the styling in the view, not the model or specification, and provides a minimal view snippet that mutes everything then highlights `cloud.backend.*`.
expectations: The response explicitly says the styling should live in the view rather than in the model or specification for this one-view customization.
The snippet includes `include *` or an equivalent rule that gives the view context.
The snippet includes a style rule that mutes the broader set, such as `style * { color muted }`.
The snippet includes a style rule that highlights `cloud.backend.*`.

comparator_method.tie_policy: Use TIE only when outputs are genuinely equivalent after rubric and expectation review.
